  \caption{\textbf{Whole-genome withheld CAFA evaluation across prospective time-based splits (\texttt{WG\_Time\_Rollover}, \texttt{WG\_Time\_Withheld}) and sequence-similarity homology splits (\texttt{WG\_Homology\_le100}, \texttt{WG\_Homology\_le70}, \texttt{WG\_Homology\_le50}, \texttt{WG\_Homology\_le30}) across six complete reference proteomes ($20{,}697$ ORFs, $3{,}809$ co-directional operons), comparing against official pre-trained and from-scratch retrained external predictors.} Six complete prokaryotic genomes (\textit{B.~subtilis} 168, \textit{P.~aeruginosa} PAO1, \textit{M.~tuberculosis} H37Rv, \textit{H.~pylori} 26695, \textit{Synechocystis} sp.\ PCC 6803, and \textit{M.~jannaschii} DSM 2661) are withheld as complete genome inputs ($20{,}697$ coding sequences, $3{,}315$ experimentally annotated target proteins, and $1{,}060$ strictly post-$t_0$ target proteins). Official pre-trained weights of DeepFRI and DeepGO-SE are evaluated on the time-based splits, and all trainable baselines (our re-implementations of DeepFRI, DeepGraphGO, TALE+, SPROF-GO, DeepGO-SE, and DPFunc over ESM-2 3B embeddings, 16-kernel DeepGOCNN and DeepGOPlus, ESM-2 3B $k$-NN/MLP/C-HMCNN, InterPro-LR, and the out-of-fold GSPA-Seq stacker) are retrained on each split's filtered training corpus (complete 130-row evaluation across all 22 methods in Supplementary Table~S4). Columns report official CAFA information-accretion-weighted $f_w$ across Molecular Function (MF), Biological Process (BP), Cellular Component (CC), and aspect mean, unweighted protein-centric $F_{\max}$ aspect mean, and the number of taxon- or anatomy-forbidden protein--term predictions ($V$) scored at or above the method's $f_w$-optimal threshold (capped at $0.25$). Ablation rows that do not enforce constraints share the GSPA-Seq count by construction. InterPro-LR, the most homology-insensitive baseline, is included on every split.}
